summary: Researched Planet Labs after its 2026-07-28 RSI-oversold transition. The USD 20.20 close fell 35.42% over the observation period and RSI reached 25.77, but the close remained above the lower Bollinger band and volume was not abnormal. Current SEC-filed Q1 FY2027 evidence shows 42% revenue growth, 99% recurring ACV, USD 816 million of RPO, USD 906 million of backlog, and USD 731 million of cash and short-term investments, with no disclosed operating impairment explaining the July 28 move. Negative free cash flow, capital intensity, cancellable government backlog, stock compensation, convertible-note dilution, and an approximately 16x forward-revenue enterprise valuation remain material. A bounded 12-month sensitivity gives 49.0% downside and a base value 24.1% below the mark, so the alert is valuation and momentum risk rather than a paper-trade opportunity. Recorded medium-confidence baseline comparability, created no strategy, and created no idea refresh because neither the payload nor an accepted canonical relationship names an idea.
